## 1. Composer file attachments (PC file → SMTP) — **DONE** (with one real limit caveat)

Full chain traced:

- **Pick/drop from PC** — `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/mail/Composer.tsx:339-348` (hidden `<input type="file" multiple>`), Attach button `:353-363`, drag-and-drop `:140-145` + overlay `:232-239`, read to base64 in-browser via `FileReader` `:46-57`, batch + caps `:95-133`, chips with remove `:304-335`.
- **Handed to the action** — `Composer.tsx:188-192` builds `SendAttachment[]`, passed at `:200` into `onSend`.
- **Wired** — `MailClient.tsx:686` renders `<Composer … onSend={handleSend}/>`; `handleSend` at `MailClient.tsx:391-398` calls `sendMessage(payload, activeAddress)`.
- **Server** — `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-mail.ts:342-376` `decodeAttachments` (base64 validation, 10-file / 20 MB caps, filename sanitising), `:400-402` in `sendMessage`, `:438` `attachments:` into nodemailer's compile transport, `:444-452` real SMTP submission with the mailbox's own credential.

**Caveat (genuine functional gap):** attachments travel inside a **Server Action** body, and `/opt/nxeon/next.config.ts:36-42` sets no `experimental.serverActions.bodySizeLimit` — Next's default is **1 MB**. nginx is fine (`scripts/configure-domains.sh:44` = 20m), but base64 inflates ~33%, so anything over roughly **700–750 KB of real file will fail** the action even though the UI (`Composer.tsx:26`) and server (`actions-mail.ts:319`) both advertise 20 MB.

## 2. Opening/downloading a received attachment — **DONE, fixed and wired**

- Attachment ids are minted as `"<uid>:<partId>"` at `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-mail.ts:244-251`.
- UI links with `part=<the whole id>`: `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/mail/ReadingPane.tsx:172-184`.
- Route tolerates that form: `/opt/nxeon/app/api/mail/attachment/route.ts:14-17` (`part = partRaw.slice(indexOf(":")+1)`), then `:38` `downloadMany`, auth/ownership at `:27` via `resolveMailbox`, safe `Content-Disposition` at `:50-60`.
- Fix is committed: `52ee318 fix: mail attachment route accepts full '<uid>:<part>' id (was Command failed on download)`.
- `partId` really is produced by mailparser (`node_modules/mailparser/lib/mail-parser.js:1024-1029`), so the ids are true IMAP part numbers, not indexes.

## 3. Rich signature + image upload + **image resize** — **DONE**

- Rich editor: `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/mail/MailSettings.tsx:297-837` (contentEditable `:761-777`, toolbar `:593-685`, templates `:780-795`, live preview `:816-831`).
- **Upload from computer**: button `:655-661` → `pickImage` `:498-502` → file input `:671-677` → `onImageFile` `:504-527` POSTs to `/api/mail/signature-image`; route `/opt/nxeon/app/api/mail/signature-image/route.ts` validates real bytes, stores in Postgres, returns an **absolute** https URL; served publicly by `/opt/nxeon/app/api/mail/signature-image/[id]/route.ts` so recipients can load it.
- **Resize IS implemented**: click an image to select (`:417-424`, `selectImg` `:354-366`), which reveals a size bar at `:688-751` — Small/Medium/Large/Full-width presets, a 40–1000 px **slider** `:708-718`, a numeric px input `:719-734`, "Original size" `:736-742`. Applied via `applyImgWidth` `:380-393` / `applyImgFull` `:395-403` (sets `width` + `max-width:100%` + `height:auto`). Selection ring class is stripped before save (`getCleanHtml` `:339-348`).
- Persistence verified: `saveMailboxSettings` sanitises with `safeHtml` (`/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-mailbox-settings.ts:181-189`), and `safeHtml` (`/opt/nxeon/lib/mail/render.ts:25-54`) does **not** strip `style` attributes — so the width survives to the recipient.
- Consumed on send: `MailClient.tsx:125-155` (`loadSig`/`sigFields`) → `Composer.tsx:167-186`.

Only nuance: resize is a **toolbar size control**, not drag handles on the image corners.

Sections (`MailSettings.tsx:39-48`): Identity, Signature, Auto-reply, Forwarding, Storage, Connection (IMAP/SMTP details), Aliases, Change password.

- **Auto-reply / vacation — STORE-ONLY.** `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-mailbox-settings.ts:241-282` writes only `db.mailbox` and the doc comment `:242-249` says so explicitly. UI carries an honest amber banner at `MailSettings.tsx:943-946`. **Nothing pushes it to Mailcow/SOGo/sieve.**
